📚 Tokenized Bonds Explained

• Tokenized bonds have been issued by governments, supranational institutions and corporations, often as pilot programs alongside traditional issuance.

• Benefits cited by issuers include faster settlement, lower administrative cost and broader potential investor access.

• Secondary market liquidity for tokenized bonds is still developing relative to traditional bond markets.
